title: Search, filters and sort work the same way on the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active parts, part A in category A and part B in category B, so the category A filter leaves part B out.
  • Have two inactive parts, part C in category A and part D in category B, so the category A filter leaves part D out.
  • Give parts A, B, C and D part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists them, and descriptions that run A to Z in the order part A, part B, part C, part D.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Pick category A in the Category filter.
  3. Pick All categories in the Category filter.
  4. Click the Description column heading.
  5. Click the Description column heading again.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  8. Pick category A in the Category filter.
  9. Pick All categories in the Category filter.
  10. Click the Description column heading.
  11. Click the Description column heading again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Active tab lists parts A and B: 2 rows.

Step 2:

  • Only part A is listed.

Step 3:

  • Parts A and B are listed again.

Step 4:

  • The rows are ordered by Description.

Step 5:

  • The order of parts A and B reverses.

Step 6:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 7:

  • The Inactive tab lists parts C and D: 2 rows.

Step 8:

  • Only part C is listed, just as the same filter left only the category A part on the Active tab.

Step 9:

  • Parts C and D are listed again.

Step 10:

  • The rows are ordered by Description.

Step 11:

  • The order of parts C and D reverses, as it did on the Active tab.
